bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11. SHIMANO is a Newcastle based three-year-old who will concede race-day experience to most when he presents on debut. He has however done enough during two trials since a spell to be treated with great respect in this class at his first start. YAMASHITA was resuming when her Kembla Grange effort over this distance was game last start. She's race-fitter now! STAR OF INDIGO has had little luck in transit during two recent starts here and she has kept trying in defeat on both occasions. COLHEITAS is another debutant who shouldn't be underestimated. She's also trialed twice since a spell and she does have ability.

raceTips.comment: Star Of Indigo has performed well at her two previous starts and is now ready to peak, will settle handy to the speed and staying at 1000m is ideal. Expecting competitive first up performances from Shimano & Colheitas over the suitable 1000m with both trialling well leading in.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11. PEYTON begins his second campaign today. He's bene partnered by Zac Lloyd during two lead-up trials at his Randwick home base and this journey should be ideal first up. EVICTION NOTICE wasn't disgraced at black type level when he tackled this trip last start at Rosehill. He is obviously far better placed here. NOT ON MY WATCH was spelled after two home based Warwick Farm trials in March. He's also trialed twice at home since his spell and he is capable of making his presence felt on debut today in this class. WRITTEN DOLL has been solid during his three start current campaign and he can be expected to maintain his consistency this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Eviction Notice was tested at Listed level last start and will appreciate the sharp drop in grade, the gelding will settle prominent to the speed throughout and not need luck in running over the suitable 1100m. The lightly raced Peyton is well placed resuming this preparation and from the inside draw will get the run of the race stalking the leading pair saved for one sprint at them late.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12. TEMPTATION was beaten at very short odds here on debut over this distance but there was an excuse and a significant gear change has now been made. She can atone today at start number two! PIAFFE performed well above market place expectations of debut at Kembla Grange and natural improvement can now be expected. ESNAAD was presented on debut over 900m at Newcastle when she clearly suggested that she will now relish the distance rise awaiting her. THE WILDLING has won a home based Rosehill trial since her honest first up Newcastle effort. She has scope to improve second up.

raceTips.comment: Tempttion has shown enough in recent outings to suggest this is within reach, with the ability to settle handy and build into the race strongly. Esnaad looks suited if able to find cover behind the speed and should have every chance to finish off solidly. Piaffe has the racing experience to give this a good shake and should be hitting the line strongly when the pressure goes on. The Wilding is another with enough ability to be competitive, particularly if able to settle comfortably in the early stages. Tempttion looks the runner with the upside to take another step forward here. Esnaad should appreciate a genuine tempo and can be dangerous late. Piaffe remains a genuine each-way chance with the right run.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 7, 8, 10. CRASH BANG WALLOP handed in a more than acceptable effort here on debut. Winkers have now been added to her gear and stepping up from only 1000m can be expected to already aid her cause. PLUME was resuming with Dylan Gibbons aboard within this distance range when she was solid at Newcastle and she can only now present race-fitter with Dylan retaining the ride. STRATFORD will concede race-day experience to all when he presents on debut today. He has however trialed on three recent occasions and this class suits at his first start. HO ALOHA and AVON CALLING are others who must be regarded as in the mix!

raceTips.comment: Plume has been racing consistently and should be suited by a race where the tempo allows it to settle and build momentum. Ho Aloha has the ability to improve with another solid effort and can be competitive if able to conserve energy early. Argansort is capable of running into the placings with the right passage and should keep working to the line. Avon Calling gets the nod on overall consistency. Plume looks the main danger and has each-way appeal. Ho Aloha can improve sharply. Argansort remains in the mix.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 8. FIFTYFIVECHEVY endured far too tough a run on the Illawarra Grange track last start. His race has produced solid form and he can regain his best form today. ICEFORD struck traffic problems first up at Kembla Grange when he did a terrific job to finish as close to the winner as he did, He has scope to improve today at only his third Australian outing. RUSH ATTACK did all but lead throughout over this distance at Newcastle last start. Switching to this circuit now aids his cause. SERPICO was resuming when he became unsuited in transit. His unplaced effort must be forgiven when he attempts a suitable distance rise this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Rush Attack looks well placed to give this a strong showing after producing competitive efforts this preparation. The gelding has enough tactical speed to settle close enough and should be strong when the pressure comes.Smart Cry has shown ability and should appreciate getting conditions to suit, with the capacity to finish off the race strongly. Fiftyfivechevy can be competitive with a clean run and should not be dismissed when assessing the chances. Rush Attack appeals as the runner with the strongest overall profile. Iceford looks suited to a stalking role. Smart Cry has definite each-way claims. Fiftyfivechevy can finish over the top of some tired runners.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 7, 8, 10. WANDA''S SPARK stepped up to tackle this trip last start at Canterbury when she led throughout at only her second start in her first preparation. She should have more to offer with that effort now behind her. FLEET FLYER was dominant when she was resuming over 1100m last start at Wyong with Louise Day aboard. Stepping up to tackle this distance should not now be an issue with Louise retaining the ride today. REGAL PROBLEM presents first up after two trials and at her first start since a stable change. She is already proven first up over this distance!  AT HER MERCY must be forgiven for recent unplaced efforts at Randwick and then at Kembla Grange when there were excuses on both occasions.

raceTips.comment: Wandas Spark looks suited by the race setup and should be able to settle in a position that gives it every opportunity to finish strongly. The mare has enough tactical speed to remain within striking distance before being asked for its effort. Fleet Flyer has been racing well enough to warrant plenty of respect and should be competitive if able to travel comfortably throughout. Zou Royal possesses the ability to run a strong race and can improve into the placings with a smooth passage. Spiritualistic is another capable of making its presence felt late and should keep finding the line. Wandas Spark gets the nod on its overall profile. Fleet Flyer looks a solid danger and can be around the money. Zou Royal has each-way claims.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 4, 8, 12. TANNIN begins his second campaign today as a three-year-old colt against older opposition. He did however do enough in his Rosehill lead-up trial to suggest that he will cope. REMEMBER JACK did a good job to finish as close to the winner as he did first up at Wyong after he was involved in early interference. A barrier blanket has now been removed and he does have scope to improve second up. MAIDOFF shouldn't be harshly judged for his first up unplaced Hawkesbury effort in a race that wasn't run to suit. Expect him to appreciate stepping up from 1100m here. LEGO MASTER must be forgiven for finishing unplaced second up at Newcastle. He struck too much trouble on the day and stepping back from 1400m should not now be regarded as a minus!

raceTips.comment: Very keen on the Michael Freedman trained Tannin resuming over the suitable 1200m, if able to reproduce the rating from his win last preparation when first up he will be very tough to beat. Remember Jack hit the line strongly when resuming over 1100m last start at Wyong, strips fitter now and will appreciate the slight step up in distance. Expido brings the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will perform strongly.
